title: DJIA Market Happenings For Friday, February 2, 2018
text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Friday, February 2, 2018 Posted by admin on February 2nd, 2018 
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include Boeing (BA), Microsoft (MSFT) and Travelers (TRV). There are no Dow stock 52 week lows. 
The Market 
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open down -199 points. 
Thursday the Dow was up +37.32 (+0.14%) at 26,186.71. 
Year-to-date the Dow is up +5.94%. 
There were 17 Dow stocks up Thursday. 
The Dow stock winners Thursday were led by Exxon Mobil (XOM) +2.03% and Disney (DIS) +1.67%. 
The Dow stock losers Thursday were led by DowDupont (DWDP) -2.75% and 3M (MMM) -1.02%. 
Apple (AAPL +0.21%) rebounded from a 3% loss and rose nearly 2% in after-hours trading on optimism its profit-margins will expand after the average selling price for the iPhone in Q1 rose 14% y/y to $796. Apple had initially declined in after-hours trading after it forecast Q2 revenue of $60 billion to $62 billion, below consensus of $65.88 billion. 
The Jobs Report says 200,000 jobs were added last month. Wall Street economists had expected an increase of about 180,000. The unemployment rate was at 4.1 percent, the same as in December and the lowest since 2000. Average earnings rose by 9 cents an hour and are up 2.9 percent over the past year. Revisions in the November and December figures produced a net loss of 24,000 jobs. 
Exxon Mobil (XOM) shares slide 3% as oil giant’s fourth-quarter earnings fall short. 
European stocks are lower and Asian markets ended mostly lower. 
The national average price of gasoline is up six-tenths of a cent at $2.601 per gallon.
